name: Camping 101: Enchanting
summary: At Brill, Vance Undergloom teaches enchanters to make an Enchanted Lute for camp. First, show proficiency in your skill.

sections.title: A Camp Companion
sections.body: At a camp in the wilds, enchanters can learn to make an Enchanted Lute. Bring it along to lend some entertainment to your time away from the trail.

faq.q: What can I learn to craft?
faq.answer: You can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp.

faq.q: Who teaches me about the lute?
faq.answer: Vance Undergloom in Brill can teach you to craft an Enchanted Lute.

faq.q: Where do I find Vance Undergloom?
What do I need before speaking with Vance?
faq.answer: Show proficiency in your skill before you learn to craft the camping item.

faq.q: Why bring an Enchanted Lute to camp?
faq.answer: The Enchanted Lute brings entertainment to your time at camp.

angles.text: As an enchanter, you can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute for camp after showing proficiency in your skill.
